opening-montage.location: Branford Train Station / Streets / Marsh Edge
opening-montage.keyElements: Dallas arrival montage + M&A planting traps + hum reaction
opening-montage.productionNotes: No dialogue. Parallel intercutting. Introduce equipment: trail cameras, boom pole, acoustic traps, folding trowels.

property-manager.keyElements: Dallas meets property manager. First full view of Dallas's face in attic.
property-manager.productionNotes: Kinetic tour with fragmented shots. Camera goes still in attic. Dallas does not say he'll take the house.

branford-night-discovery.productionNotes: Dallas discovers weirdness of neighborhood and tall grass

dallas-night-work.productionNotes: REWRITE: Remove Howie character - Dallas explores alone using oscillator

shotList.title: Train station arrival
shotList.description: Dallas exits train at Branford station, picks up suitcase, walks toward station exit. Long Island Sound visible beyond.

shotList.title: Walking through Branford streets (montage)
shotList.description: Dallas walks through residential Branford neighborhood toward rental house. Intercurs with Makayla & Asher setting up equipment in marsh.

shotList.title: Property Manager House Tour
shotList.description: Dallas meets property manager at front door and tours rental house. Progresses from foyer through living room, kitchen, backyard observation, and attic.

shotList.title: Kitchen hum
shotList.description: Dallas settles into the kitchen, clocks the first faint hum, and marks the frequency before the sound cuts.

shotList.title: Driveway edge
shotList.description: Dallas steps outside, watches the driveway and the property line, and feels the hum merge out of the tall grass.

shotList.title: Attic boxes
shotList.description: In the attic, Dallas opens Sierra's box, finds the field notes, cassette player, headphones, and old recorder.

shotList.title: Bathroom tape
shotList.description: The shower drowns everything out until the cassette tape and the distant hum start bleeding into the bathroom.

shotList.title: Downstairs pulse
shotList.description: Downstairs, Dallas records the pulsing tone, tracks the pattern, and loses the battery mid-read.

shotList.title: House exterior glow
shotList.description: Outside again, Dallas watches the grass sway as the golden glow pulses and a storm builds over Branford.

shotList.title: Into the neighborhoods
shotList.description: Dallas tracks the pulsing hum through suburban streets and toward the marsh.

shotList.title: Marsh edge approach
shotList.description: Dallas reaches the tall marsh, realizes the sound is intensifying from the grass itself.

shotList.title: Nursery exploration
shotList.description: Dallas searches the East Haven Nursery grounds with oscillator, tracking the frequency.

shotList.title: The injured creature
shotList.description: Dallas discovers something in the tall grass - evidence of an animal or disturbance.

shotList.title: Jerry's house approach
shotList.description: Dallas arrives at Jerry's house in evening darkness, oscillator still active.

shotList.title: Something in the shadows
shotList.description: Dallas hears movement or shadows around the house perimeter - the hum intensifies.

shotList.title: Makayla and Asher arrive
shotList.description: Makayla and Asher pull up to the Dallas house with equipment and gear.

shotList.title: Dallas greets them
shotList.description: Dallas emerges from house, first meeting with Makayla and Asher on the property.

shotList.title: House and grounds tour
shotList.description: Dallas shows them around the property - house interior briefly, then focuses on the grounds and marsh views.

shotList.title: The sound begins
shotList.description: Dallas, Dominic, and Pat experience the hum directly for the first time - it starts low and builds.

shotList.title: Attempt to track it
shotList.description: They try to locate the source - moving with equipment, oscillator in hand.

shotList.title: The revelation
shotList.description: They narrow down that the sound is coming from the tall grass itself - the source becomes clear.

shotList.title: Merlin app search
shotList.description: They consult field guides and use the Merlin app to try identifying what could produce this sound.

shotList.title: Dead ends
shotList.description: They realize no known bird species matches the frequency or pattern - confusion and concern.

shotList.title: Field journal discovery
shotList.description: The group gathers to examine Sierra's field journal closely - detailed notes and sketches about the hum.

shotList.title: Reading Sierra's notes
shotList.description: Dallas reads passages aloud - Sierra's observations about the creature and the hum pattern.

shotList.title: Matching the frequency
shotList.description: They use the oscillator to match the frequency noted in Sierra's journal - confirmation of the pattern.

shotList.title: Planning the investigation
shotList.description: They devise a plan to explore the marsh more thoroughly based on Sierra's notes - mapping out grid search.

shotList.title: Equipment check
shotList.description: They methodically check equipment - oscillators, recorders, safety gear - preparing for marsh expedition.

shotList.title: Near encounter
shotList.description: As they prepare to head out, something moves in the tall grass visible from the house - they almost discover the creature.

shotList.title: Return through darkness
shotList.description: Dallas makes his way back through the darkening neighborhoods, disoriented.

shotList.title: Evening arrival at location
shotList.description: Dallas, Dominic, and Asher arrive at the evening location to explore - golden hour light.

shotList.title: Tracking the hum
shotList.description: They move through the area with equipment, oscillator active, following frequency changes.

shotList.title: Dominic's hesitation
shotList.description: Dominic expresses doubt or fear about continuing deeper - tension within the group.

shotList.title: The burn mark discovery
shotList.description: They discover a distinctive burn mark on the ground or trees - evidence of the creature's presence.

shotList.title: Oscillator confirmation
shotList.description: The oscillator shows maximum response at the burn mark - confirmation this is where the creature was.

shotList.title: The realization
shotList.description: They understand the creature is real, local, and active - the threat becomes tangible.

shotList.title: Setting up the experiment
shotList.description: Dallas and Makayla carefully arrange equipment for a test - oscillator, resonance chamber, recording devices.

shotList.title: The test begins
shotList.description: They activate the oscillator and begin recording - waiting to see if it attracts the creature or proves something.

shotList.title: Nothing happens
shotList.description: The test fails - no response, no creature, no confirmation. Disappointment and concern.

shotList.title: The tracking box explained
shotList.description: Dallas shows Makayla a custom-built tracking device - Sierra's design notes form the basis.

shotList.title: Building the device
shotList.description: They work together building or calibrating the tracker - precision work, focused collaboration.

shotList.title: First calibration
shotList.description: They calibrate the tracker to match the hum frequency - excitement as it responds.

shotList.title: Dominic arrives
shotList.description: Dominic shows up - he has something to say, something weighing on him.

shotList.title: The confession
shotList.description: Dominic reveals something he knows or has experienced - guilt, fear, or vital information about the creature.

shotList.title: Processing the revelation
shotList.description: They process what Dominic has told them - silence, questions, dawning realization.

shotList.title: Entering the grass
shotList.description: The group enters the tall marsh for the first time - a coordinated expedition into the unknown.

shotList.title: The hum intensifies
shotList.description: As they go deeper, the hum becomes overwhelming - their equipment goes wild.

shotList.title: The creature is there
shotList.description: They encounter or sense the creature directly - a moment of terrible clarity.

shotList.title: The rescue
shotList.description: Something goes wrong - someone in danger, the group mobilizes to rescue/protect.

shotList.title: Escape from grass
shotList.description: They retreat from the grass, shaken and bloodied - barely making it out.

shotList.title: Coordinates discovered
shotList.description: The group deciphers a coordinate pattern from Sierra's notes and the hum frequency, pinpointing a location deep in the marsh.

shotList.title: The plan forms
shotList.description: With coordinates identified, the group debates whether to act — tension between urgency and caution.

shotList.title: The life group arrives
shotList.description: An unexpected crowd arrives — the Life Group, led by Janice, showing up for a scheduled gathering nobody cancelled.

shotList.title: Awkward coexistence
shotList.description: The Life Group settles in while the core group scrambles to conceal their investigation and equipment.

shotList.title: The hymn begins
shotList.description: The Life Group begins singing — a slow, resonant hymn with a frequency eerily close to the hum.

shotList.title: Frequencies align
shotList.description: As the hymn swells, the hum beneath it rises in response — the frequencies begin to mirror each other.

shotList.title: Red eyes in the dark
shotList.description: As the hymn peaks, someone near a window sees the creature — two red points of light in the dark grass.

shotList.title: The secret is out
shotList.description: The Life Group member screams. The room erupts. Dallas can no longer contain what's been happening.

shotList.title: Additional creature effects
shotList.description: Pickup shots of the creature's arrival - additional angles and close coverage of destruction.

shotList.title: Defensive positions
shotList.description: Close coverage of the group defending themselves - intimate shots in shadows.

shotList.title: The hum at maximum
shotList.description: Extreme close-ups of the hum's effects - sensory overload captured intimately.

shotList.title: The warning additional coverage
shotList.description: Pickup shots of Mr. Mike's crucial warning - wider angles and group reactions.

shotList.title: Plan details captured
shotList.description: Close coverage of the escape/defense plan being explained - technical detail shots.

shotList.title: Resolution and commitment
shotList.description: Final commitment to the plan - intimate captures of determination and fear.

shotList.title: Resonance begins
shotList.description: The hum reaches a specific frequency that causes physical reaction - glasses vibrate, equipment resonates.

shotList.title: Physical effects
shotList.description: The resonance intensifies - people feel it in their bodies, some hurt, disorientation.

shotList.title: A normal day memory
shotList.description: Amongst the chaos, someone recalls or experiences a flash of normal life - brief respite.

shotList.title: Mute drive
shotList.description: Without speaking, communicating through looks and gestures - all sound is overwhelmed.

shotList.title: Mr. Mike's warning
shotList.description: Mr. Mike reveals something crucial about the creature or warns the group of danger ahead.

shotList.title: The escape plan
shotList.description: They devise a plan to either trap, communicate with, or escape from the creature.

shotList.title: The fellowship gathers
shotList.description: All the main characters come together - Dallas, Dominic, Makayla, Asher, Mr. Mike - a final gathering.

shotList.title: Before the finale
shotList.description: Last moments before the final confrontation - memories shared, decisions confirmed.

shotList.title: News vans arrive
shotList.description: The outside world intrudes - media arrives in Branford, cameras and crew setting up.
